system.description:
Cybernetic implant (Tier 2). Installing it gives you 1 permanent Trauma (−1 max Hope), even if the implant is later swapped out. Identically named features don't stack. Track the Trauma on the character sheet yourself; it is not applied automatically.

Neural-Link: Advantage on rolls to manipulate and bypass computer systems.
